functions.name: create_task
functions.title: Create task
functions.description: Create a new task for the signed-in user. The title is checked for profanity and rejected if it contains any.

functions.name: update_task
functions.title: Update task
functions.description: Change a task's title and/or completed status. A new title is checked for profanity and rejected if it contains any.

id.description: ID of the task to update.

completed.description: Whether the task is completed. Optional.
